cond_0001.intro: This position supports the Quality Assurance Operation, which consists of QA Production Floor supports, and QA Product Release.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Provide Quality support to Manufacturing personnel for compounding and in-process checks. Perform line clearance verification, sterilization chart review, scale calibration verification, and QA in-process checks including but not limited to visual inspection, CISIT/PID test, weight check, and torque test. Prepare in-process samples for submission to the Quality Control Laboratory. Support handling of GMP events and initiation of deviation investigations. Read, understand, and follow SOP's and complies with cGMP. Support the issuance of GMP documentation to Manufacturing floor. Review executed batch records for completeness, accuracy and compliance with Good Documentation Practices. Use computerized system such as SAP, LIMS, and TrackWise for data collection and batch record review. Scan and file batch records (physically & electronically). Perform other work-related duties as assigned by management.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
General high school degree/GED or equivalent
Basic reading, writing, and math skills
1-2 Years' experience working in a Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or other FDA regulated industries
Good computer skills
Strong attention to detail
Good oral and written communication skills
Ability to work overtime and/or work occasionally on weekend as needed
Preferred Requirements
Some college or technical college
Prior experience working in a QA function

Perform line clearance verification, sterilization chart review, scale calibration verification, and QA in-process checks including but not limited to visual inspection, CISIT/PID test, weight check, and torque test. Prepare in-process samples for submission to the Quality Control Laboratory. Support handling of GMP events and initiation of deviation investigations — raising issues early and connecting with the right people to move them forward. Read, understand, and follow SOP's and comply with cGMP. Support the issuance of GMP documentation to the Manufacturing floor. Review executed batch records for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with Good Documentation Practices, and walk team members through findings as needed. Use computerized systems such as SAP, LIMS, and TrackWise for data collection and batch record review. Scan and file batch records (physically and electronically). Perform other work-related duties as assigned by management.
cond_0060.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Basic reading, writing, and math skills
Good computer skills
Strong attention to detail
Good oral and written communication skills — you will regularly interact with Manufacturing personnel and QC staff
General high school degree/GED or equivalent
1–2 Years' experience working in a Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or other FDA regulated industry
Ability to work overtime and/or occasionally on weekends as needed
Preferred Requirements
Some college or technical college
Prior experience working in a QA function

cond_0126.responsibilities: Provide Quality support to Manufacturing personnel for compounding and in-process checks. Collaborate with relevant teams to review executed batch records for completeness, accuracy and compliance with Good Documentation Practices. Use computerized systems such as SAP, LIMS, and TrackWise for data collection and batch record review. Scan and file batch records (physically & electronically). Perform other work-related duties as assigned by management.

Provide quality support to Manufacturing personnel for compounding and in-process checks.
Perform line clearance verification, sterilization chart review, scale calibration verification, and QA in-process checks including but not limited to visual inspection, CISIT/PID test, weight check, and torque test.
Prepare in-process samples for submission to the Quality Control Laboratory.
Support handling of GMP events and initiation of deviation investigations.
Read, understand, and follow SOPs and comply with cGMP.
Support the issuance of GMP documentation to the Manufacturing floor.
Review executed batch records for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with Good Documentation Practices.
Use computerized systems such as SAP, LIMS, and TrackWise for data collection and batch record review.
Scan and file batch records (physically and electronically).
Perform other work-related duties as assigned by management.
cond_0286.requirements:
Good computer skills
Strong attention to detail
Clear written communication and direct verbal reporting
Ability to work overtime and/or occasionally on weekends as needed
General high school degree/GED or equivalent required
Some college or technical college preferred
Prior experience working in a QA function preferred
Basic reading, writing, and math skills required
1-2 Years' experience working in a Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or other FDA regulated industry required
cond_0286.values: We value excellence in execution and a clear focus on results. We aim to produce work that reflects high standards and a strong commitment to performance.

cond_0454.responsibilities: Provide Quality support to Manufacturing personnel for compounding and in-process checks. Perform line clearance verification, sterilization chart review, scale calibration verification, and QA in-process checks including but not limited to visual inspection, CISIT/PID test, weight check, and torque test. Prepare in-process samples for submission to the Quality Control Laboratory. Support handling of GMP events and initiation of deviation investigations. Read, understand, and follow SOP's and complies with cGMP. Support the issuance of GMP documentation to Manufacturing floor. Review executed batch records for completeness, accuracy and compliance with Good Documentation Practices. Use computerized system such as SAP, LIMS, and TrackWise for data collection and batch record review. Scan and file batch records (physically & electronically). Perform other work-related duties as assigned by management.

Good computer skills.
Strong attention to detail.
